briefs.label: APEC
briefs.text: Xi pledges $20m for APEC cooperation and a Shenzhen study centre.

briefs.label: UK · AI
briefs.text: MPs: close AI safety gaps to secure a £400bn growth prize, Parliament warns.

briefs.label: COURTS
briefs.text: McDonald's bid to block 450 UK staff claims fails; full hearing to follow.

briefs.label: MOROCCO
briefs.text: Defence roadmap unveiled: 50,000 jobs and 65% export revenue by 2035.

briefs.label: BENIN
briefs.text: Seeks return of 35 looted artworks from France, including a 1.65m god Gou statue.

briefs.label: SCIENCE
briefs.text: mRNA vaccine design shows broad protection against Nipah and Hendra viruses.

briefs.label: SPORT
briefs.text: NBA: Bulls rout Nets 137–107; Heat beat Bucks 137–130 as Milwaukee falls to 1–14.

briefs.label: SPACE
briefs.text: NASA JPL hosts a live Voyager discussion at 17:00 UTC.

briefs.label: JAKARTA
briefs.text: Estonian tech and maritime firms in town for digital and smart-port talks.

briefs.label: INDONESIA
briefs.text: Heavy-rain alert in effect across 19 provinces through today, BMKG warns.

briefs.label: USA
briefs.text: Atmospheric-river storm rolls into Thursday; flood watch in LA, feet of Sierra snow.

briefs.label: UK · MEDIA
briefs.text: Government asks Google to deactivate Russell Brand's YouTube channel.

cards.body: First trade today as ANT. Priced at $83 — above its $70–78 range — raising $81.3bn, the largest IPO ever. Valuation near $1.5tn.
cards.headline: Anthropic debuts on Nasdaq

cards.body: Storm bears down on Odisha and Andhra Pradesh; landfall due Friday noon. Winds 90–100 km/h. Red alert in 10 districts; 74 rescue teams out.
cards.headline: 47,000 flee Cyclone Akvan

cards.body: Ministers haggle in Antalya over the draft deal — fossil-fuel phaseout and adaptation finance — before the summit closes Friday.
cards.headline: COP31 enters final 48 hours

cards.body: Russia struck the capital in the early hours; four wounded in the region, energy grid hit in Odesa. A Shahed fell in the Lypky district.
cards.headline: Drones strike Kyiv overnight

cards.body: Foreign and defence ministers meet in Tokyo — defence co-development, maritime security and joint exercises top the agenda.
cards.headline: India and Japan hold 2+2 talks

cards.body: Final report: her hidden wind vulnerability was never assessed at anchor. 80mph gusts capsized her in under 15 seconds; seven died in August 2024.
cards.headline: Bayesian crew 'unaware of risk'

cards.body: Conference at Iveagh House: Troubles legacy law and Northern Ireland's budget, ahead of the Good Friday Agreement's 30th anniversary.
cards.headline: UK and Irish ministers meet

cards.body: Young Britons could work and study in the EU by 2028 under a draft deal — The i Paper's front-page exclusive, ahead of Friday's UK–EU summit.
cards.headline: Under-30s set for EU visas

cards.body: Ground rents capped at £250 a year from 2028; commonhold becomes the default for new flats. Around 5m leasehold homes in England and Wales.
cards.headline: Leasehold Bill enters Parliament

excluded.text: Israeli tanks cross Gaza Yellow Line
Ruto's State of the Nation address

heroes.body: The first-ever three-way summit: one hour at Kylin Villa, 14:30 local. Nuclear arms, Ukraine, Iran, trade and AI on the table. A separate Trump–Putin bilateral is planned.
heroes.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet today

heroes.body: Midnight launch, New Zealand first, after a 13-year wait. Metacritic 99 from 140+ reviews. 2.3m watching on Twitch by midday in Paris. $79.99 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S — no PC yet.
heroes.headline: GTA VI is out today

heroes.body: The Gambia v. Myanmar: did the 2017 campaign against the Rohingya — 730,000+ fled to Bangladesh — amount to genocide? Judgment at 10:00. The first such ruling in over a decade.
heroes.headline: ICJ rules today on Myanmar
